title: Deeper conditional-class fillers: Term-7 enumeration, Demazure sub-crystals, KL classical limit, BlochGroup carrier, $\mathrm{Cl}_2$ pentagon
html:
The five required Mathlib extensions are consolidated into a single synthesis class.

Required are finite-type enumeration for height-6 partitions and a Demazure sub-crystal predicate for resonance tracking; the Kazhdan-Lusztig functor mapping elements to the symmetric group; and, finally, the Bloch group formal quotient and the associated 5-term pentagon identity.

These extensions demand substantial upstream formalisation. The current scaffolding successfully isolates them, allowing the mass-tower derivation to proceed conditionally.
